activity.role: Polish-language poet, first volume of Poetry including Ballads and Romances published in Vilnius
activity.notes: The first volume of Mickiewicz's Poetry including Ballads and Romances appeared in Vilnius in 1822 under the contemporary Russian Empire; this is a contextual sovereign polity at the publication site, NOT a claim of Russian ethnicity or service to the imperial government. His historical contribution is central to Polish Romantic literature.
